items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] George Bakay had been there, but he's dead now too.

ctx.x: You didn't? No. Oh, he had a whole way in quite a few of those. What's this fellow's name in Philadelphia from the Orleans? George something. George Bishop, not Bishop.
George Bakay had been there, but he's dead now too. Oh, is that so?
